text: {"findings":[{"rule":"K1","where":"IdentityRegistry.isVerified / Deployment._registerInvestors","severity":"HIGH","why":"isVerified returns true as soon as any one required topic has a valid claim, but the policy requires a valid claim for every required topic. Investor m has only the KYC_TOPIC claim, not TOPIC_2, yet is treated as verified and can receive tokens.","steps":"1) Agent calls token.mint(m, 1) (or any holder calls transfer(m, x)). 2) isVerified(m) returns true because the topic-1 claim is valid, so the transfer or mint succeeds."},{"rule":"K2","where":"IdentityRegistry.isVerified / _topicOk, with ClaimIssuer.revokeClaim","severity":"HIGH","why":"Revoking the KYC_TOPIC claim only invalidates that one claim. Because isVerified uses OR across topics, b still passes via its valid TOPIC_2 claim, so a wallet whose KYC was revoked can still receive tokens.","steps":"1) issuerAdmin calls claimIssuer.revokeClaim(keccak256(abi.encode(claimIssuer, KYC_TOPIC)), idB). 2) Holder calls token.transfer(b, amount). isVerified(b) is still true via the TOPIC_2 claim, so the transfer succeeds."}]}
